steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL, waited for the visible launcher and saved this criterion's initial PNG. Opened GIS with no pre-existing selected layers/detail tabs; opened Automobile configuration and its nested Test type choices. Selected generic Call (distinct from MS Teams Call), retaining all default technologies, blank handset/network filters and the rolling 29 July–27 October 2026 date window, unless a later step says otherwise. Added Automobile - Call and captured settled configuration/map transitions. Observed GET /api/platform/automobile/filter-options and GET /api/platform/automobile/call/points succeed with HTTP 200.

Used Search Map for 52.20087, 0.12085 at zoom 14; clicked the returned aggregate at 52.20255705185695, 0.1242828369140625 using its Mercator screen projection. POST /api/platform/automobile/call/cluster-details returned point 132006263, a Success test starting 2026-08-19T09:34:39.647 and ending 09:35:49.647 (70000 ms). POST /api/platform/automobile/call/test-analysis returned HTTP 200 and 33 samples.

Inspected the settled chart and hovered within it. The tooltip showed elapsed time 12.72 and Signal strength -104 only. The x-axis spans approximately 0–120 seconds, including pre/post-call samples; the 70-second test lies within this range. Saved detail-open and final chart PNGs. The chart's only visible series/legend is Signal strength; the table separately contains Call State and Service, which does not prove chart coverage.

Closed only this criterion's created detail tabs and removed its Automobile layer. Cleared the search field; launcher navigation reset transient page state between criteria. No saved data, favourites or maps were created. Map center/zoom were changed during testing and were not restored to the exact original viewport; original layer and detail selections were empty and restored.

after.reason: Focused live check on 2 November: the built-in expanded Call analysis view for 5 October 2026, 19:35:02 displays Call initiated (CI), Connected (CC) and Call ended (CE) annotations over the signal-strength timeline spanning the 70-second test. The readable returned samples show Idle, Off Hook and Connected transitions; the chart marks initiation, connection and end. The source asks for call state over time, without prescribing a separate continuous state series or lane. The prior Unverified interpretation imposed that extra presentation requirement. Service technology is shown as Service in the same analysis view, accepted by the user. This is a source-aligned reassessment with a fresh chart capture, not a new full attempt.

Compared the chart presentation with the actual copied source ticket: it does not require a continuous state lane. Captured the unmodified expanded window with annotations, summary and sample states together.
Closed the owned detail window/tab, restored the pre-existing MS Teams layer and camera at zoom16. No simulation or product changes.
